title: English Practice Quiz 0987
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A strong password should generally be ___.
questions.explanation: Long, unique passwords are harder to guess.

questions.question: Two-factor authentication adds ___.
questions.explanation: It requires another proof of identity beyond the password.

questions.question: A file ending in .pdf is commonly a ___.
questions.explanation: PDF is a widely used document file format.

questions.question: A browser is software used to ___.
questions.explanation: Browsers display and interact with web pages.

questions.question: Before clicking an unfamiliar email link, check ___.
options: the sender and the destination address
questions.explanation: Sender and link checks can reveal suspicious messages.

questions.question: Cloud storage keeps files on ___.
questions.explanation: Cloud services store data on remote servers.

questions.question: To 'download' a file means to ___.
options: receive it from another system onto your device
questions.explanation: Downloading transfers a file to your device.

questions.question: A software update may include ___.
questions.explanation: Updates often fix vulnerabilities and improve software.

questions.question: A QR code is usually scanned to ___.
options: open linked information or a service
questions.explanation: QR codes encode data such as a web link.

questions.question: A backup is important because it can ___.
questions.explanation: Backups provide copies that can be restored after data loss.
